description: She wears a russet-red woven floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length split sleeves over a cream underdress. Gold-tan geometric borders outline the neckline, bodice seams, cuffs, skirt opening and hem. A decorated woven girdle has two round metal ornaments. A cream wrap with russet-and-gold borders drapes around the forearms; gold drop earrings and brown leather sandals are visible. No headgear, armor or weapons appear.
